title: Owen Alfred Holds Nothing Back On His Recent Song "Indomie Noodles"
htmlContent:
Owen Alfred is a multi-talented lyrical genius based in Limerick, Ireland. The young artist significantly tells us how a young upcoming artist struggled with everyday life, from being surrounded by violence and poverty to becoming successful and more prosperous than he once was in his recent song, "Indomie Noodles."

Fast-rising artist Owen Alfred brings an incredible sound that can't be denied on the new song "Indomie Noodles." The artistry and presence on the track are the stuff of legends, as he carries the track masterfully with his high-energy vocals full of charisma and lyrics that make his pen beyond respectable.
